changelog:
Pairing with a television accepts nine-digit codes only.

WHAT CHANGED

- The pairing scanner and the typed-in code accepted six digits as
  well as nine, for televisions that had not updated yet. Every code
  has been nine digits for days, so a six-digit one could only be old
  or mistyped; it is now refused on the phone instead of by the server.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything else, including 0.3.3.17's update check on every start.
